_notes.what: Seconds each browser journey takes in CI, by journey name. Every journey that is not held (tests/browser/held.mjs) has an entry and every entry is a journey in tests/browser/journeys, or tests/browser/shard.test.mjs fails; a held journey may keep its entry, so holding one keeps it and un-holding one needs one. selectShard (tests/browser/shard.mjs) balances the shards with them: the longest journey first, each to the shard with the least total so far.
_notes.source: Each value is the journey's median over the browser jobs of CI runs 43590492908, 43594819791, 43624866557, 43627104397 and 43969692549 and Pages runs 43644004174, 43767073800, 43992517502 and 44203696644 (started 2026-11-14 to 2026-11-17; the journey's '✓ name (N s)' line in each job log, CI and Pages pooled, as both run on the same runners), rounded up to whole seconds. Every journey here has CI times from those runs but r2-event-jump, r2-flight-wall, r2-transport-fit, r2-transport-fit-clock and r2-transport-fit-launch (Redesign A step 2), which CI has not timed yet: their entries are estimates, half each journey's timeoutMs (600 s, so 300 s; r2-flight-wall exports none, so half of 180 s, 90 s), until the first five-shard CI runs give their medians. r2-viewport-matrix and r2-viewport-matrix-phone are estimates too, by the same rule (600 s and 360 s, half of 1200 s and 720 s): on 2026-11-20 r2-viewport-matrix was split into its desktop sizes and r2-viewport-matrix-phone, its phone sizes, so the runs above timed neither part alone. In 26 runs of the whole journey, in 16 CI runs on 2026-11-19 (44522372109, its second attempt, to 44629661945), the desktop part took a median of 469.15 s and the phone part 237.25 s, by the journey's own log lines. i18n-loader (EQ-6 step 3, 2026-11-26) is an estimate by the same rule, half of its 240 s timeoutMs, 120 s, until CI has timed it.
_notes.refresh: A new journey gets its entry in the PR that adds it, and a held one without an entry in the PR that un-holds it, or tests/browser/shard.test.mjs and every sharded run fail naming it: until CI has timed it, half its timeoutMs in seconds, or half of 180 s (DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS in tests/browser/harness.mjs) when it exports none. To refresh the table, take each journey's seconds from the browser reports of recent CI and Pages runs (journeys[].seconds in browser-NofM.report.json, in the ci-evidence-browser-N and pages-evidence-browser-N artifacts), write the median per journey rounded up to whole seconds, and name the runs under source.
_notes.units: Seconds, each a positive whole number.
